project_type: TanStack Start (React SSR) + Vite, with TypeScript
verification_instructions: Run `npm run dev` to start development server. Run `npm test` to execute unit tests. Use `npm run lint` for code quality checks.
environment_constraints: Connected to Lovable - avoid force pushing or rewriting published git history. Must use TanStack file routes under src/routes. Lazy-load browser-dependent components behind ClientOnly for SSR safety. Never push directly to main without explicit request.
contribution_requirements: Keep LomusTrack screens under src/features/lomustrack. Use TanStack file-based routing (not React Router). Load browser-dependent providers lazily. Per AGENTS.md: preserve existing integrations, filters, authentication, and data fetching.
key_patterns: Dashboard uses: (1) DashboardConfig state stored in localStorage with activeCards array, (2) @dnd-kit/* for existing drag-and-drop of sidebar metrics, (3) Sheet component for sidebar drawer, (4) Collapsible accordions for metric categories, (5) useDashboard hook for data/filters, (6) Card components from ui/card.tsx, (7) Recharts for all charts, (8) KpiCard pattern for metric cards. The existing DashboardEditor.tsx already implements basic sidebar with categories and reordering within activeCards, but lacks: grid layout system, widget resize, drag from sidebar to canvas, persistent positioning, widget configuration, and advanced widget controls.
directory_structure: src/features/lomustrack/ contains feature modules (dashboard/, sales/, campaigns/, etc.). Each feature has an index.tsx and components/ subdirectory. src/components/ui/ holds shadcn/ui design system components. src/hooks/ contains custom React hooks. src/services/ contains API request functions. src/types/ defines TypeScript interfaces. src/routes/ uses TanStack file-based routing (_dashboard.dashboard.tsx loads the dashboard feature). package.json already includes @dnd-kit and react-grid-layout dependencies.
